Because at the end of the day, were all trying to make it through everyday with our best effort, because, at the end of the day, were all Erenians, sitting on our little planet. Aint that right?
A shell-shocked Major Al-Jabri

[spoiler=Beginning of negotiations with SILF and Kaaganikan diplomats]
-June 29th, 2025
The diplomats and president were taken to a private location, faraway from the frontlines to speak of a potential pause to the conflict, potentially even a peace agreement. The idea of a ceasefire after months of conflict was very enticing, especially to the SILF members, who often had to go to the fronts due to lack of decent communication and supplies.
The president and SILF leaders are sat down on a circular table, across from each other. The meeting is held with traditional West Shamatian food in the middle, to the request of the Kaaganikan president.
So, Ayoub Tazi begins. We are all aware of why we are here.
Yes, to discuss a potential solution to the situation in Kaaganika. We suggest that the SILF get together to make their own state, since our people do not wish to be a part of this new communist regime.
The president ponders for a moment, before asking, And why not? We had no plans of oppressing the Islamic people in our nation. We simply wish for the workers in our nation to have the freedoms they deserve, kept safe from capitalism and oppression from wealth. It wouldnt make very much sense to secede if Baladullah does not want to support your rebel groups.
We desire an autonomous state in the south, where our Araby populations in Kaaganika live.
Ayoub Tazi was an understanding man, despite having shown the past presidents head in front of a crowd, he wasnt a psychopath, and was willing to give this state to them, much to the surprise of the group members.
With the help of delicious snacks on the table and the willingness of Tazi, negotiations are brought from cold to very positive. Two autonomous states are to be created in the south, among other reconstruction programs to help rebuild the devastated south. Another problem arose, however. The problem was finding a nation to oversee the development of a peace treaty of some kind.
Why dont we have the IPEA oversee it?
Why? They havent done anything to get peace to happen anywhere! Baladullah has quite literally turned a blind eye to our situation while their citizens watch missiles and drone strikes across the border like a TALENT SHOW! They have done, NOTHING! And I mean, NOTHING, to help our situation, and neither has the rest of the world. I refuse to believe they would do anything to help our situation, they literally are watching us burn!
They are going to be doing nothing at the Nestor-Sikirsk treaty because theyre too weak to do anything! [nation]Tel Scadu[/nation] has gotten themselves diplomatically ******  and left out of the  Kaiserreich-Sikirsk peace treaty because they wanted to join the alliance and had to pull out their warship, and they STILL arent in. Its these things that prove the big powers of Erene just want to rule the world, which is why were not doing it with either of those two.
No. Im not doing it. And certainly not with another peacekeeping alliance. We need a neutral nation to sign our peace treaty with.
The SILF was mostly in agreement with a little bit of more debating. The problem was clear. They needed a neutral nation to sign their peace treaty in.[/spoiler]
[spoiler=TLDR] The president of Kaaganika and the SILF leaders met up in a private location, and discussions were extremely positive and productive, thanks to Tazis willingness for an autonomous state in the south for the Arabys. However, they both agreed they didnt want foreign influencers, especially IPEA for their lack of support or actions to help end the conflict. They are now looking for a neutral nation to overlook the signing of a peace treaty.[/spoiler]
If you didnt read this, dont worry. [u]We are now looking for a neutral nation that is willing to overlook the signing of a peace treaty for safety reasons.[/u]
The president of Kaaganika, Ayoub Tazi, is very against having the IPEA overlook it, seeing the Baladullahan lack of action as cruel, as their citizens on the far west could very much see Southern Kaaganika burning down, while they send diplomats to a peace treaty they cant influence, the reason why Tazi considers them weak
The SILF members are very much against having any kind of Sikirskan or Kaiserreich influence, fearing the peace treaty could end up warping them into a sphere of influence, something the leaders were hardcore against.
